messages:
anita: Quick heads-up — SurgeBoard EAP NDA landed. They want a short benchmark run and a telemetry hook by next Wednesday. Can we confirm logistics?

mike: Nice. Do we have the shipping window for the dev kit?

anita: FedEx pickup scheduled Mon 10/02. ETA Wed 10/04 to our lab. PM'd logistics team.

lucas: I'll own the benchmark recipe. Plan: 3 configs (fp16, int8 q4, int4). Small perf runs + memory profile. Need a sample prompt set from partner.

emma: @lucas please include distributed infer test (2x A100) — SurgeBoard will mirror in their lab.

lucas: noted. Draft of commands below, can tweak:

```
# run single-node perf
python bench.py --model rdw-open-7b --tokens 1024 --batch 8 --quant int8 --trace telemetry.json
```

sara: For telemetry: SurgeBoard wants CPU/GPU power & temp + per-request latency. We should strip PII; use synthetic IDs.

anita: Confirmed — legal signed NDA v1.2. Copy attached in DM. @sara please follow up on telemetry schema and privacy checklist.

sara: Will do. Proposed fields: request_id, model_version, seq_len, gpu_util, power_w, temp_c, latency_ms, error_flag

mike: Can we send a lightweight agent to the dev kit? i.e., `rdw-telemetry-agent` container that just POSTs to our collector.

lucas: I can make a minimal agent. Need collector endpoint + api-key. @anita can you get keys for surgeboard-sandbox?

anita: Requested keys from infra. ETA EOD today. Also, SurgeBoard asked about embargo on results — 2 weeks after final dataset. OK?

emma: Two weeks is fine. We'll tighten release notes: no model-specific claims without PM sign-off.

lucas: Timeline check: bench recipe ready Tue, runs Wed/Thu, initial report Fri. Does that fit with shipping?

anita: Yes. Ship arrives Wed, bench Wed-Thu. Let's sync 1pm Tue for final recipe review. :calendar: 

ir-bot: Incident detector: none. Schedule OK.

mike: Adding checklist item — backup power & surge suppressors for the lab rack. Last time we saw flaky readings without it.

anita: Great catch. I'll add to ops manifest.
